42/G.goal: Explain how XR system implementation uses prototyping and usability evaluation through the design-prototype-evaluate cycle and common prototype forms.
42/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for planning, building, and evaluating prototypes in the course case study, supporting confident implementation of an XR system.

42/O1.goal: Explain where and why prototyping and usability evaluation occur in XR system implementation.
42/O1.achieves: It lets the learner place the design-prototype-evaluate cycle in the interactive system development lifecycle and understand the need for quick iterative evaluation before final construction.

42/O2.goal: Describe the forms of prototypes used to test XR interfaces before full implementation.
42/O2.achieves: It lets the learner recognize how prototypes can be discarded or evolved and which prototyping approach tests appearance, interaction, functionality, or ideas before the technology exists.
